messages.author: 1bd043dc49f3e3c4
messages.subject: unexpectedly exited...dumped to Javascript console?
parts:
I have a ShinyApp which has been running locally with no problems, and I just loaded it to the alpha version of shinyapps. It works intermittently for a few seconds (it will load data and allow users to make a few reactive changes, but it then crashes or freezes completely, displaying a message:

"application unexpectedly exited.
Diagnostic information has been dumped to the Java Script error console."

Any thoughts?  This is my first experience using the hosting option for shinyApps (which the package is awesome btw), and I'm just learning shiny.

Thanks,
R

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: unexpectedly exited...dumped to Javascript console?
parts:
Ryan,

I suspect the issue is that your application is running out of memory if its starting up and then crashing. By default, application instances are deployed using the 'small' instance type and limited to 256MB of memory. You should read the Configuring Shiny Applications section in the Getting Started Guide, and try redeploying your application using a larger instance type. If it seems to still be crashing, we can look into it further and see what is going on here.

-Andy

# server.R
library(plotGoogleMaps)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    output$map3 <- renderUI({
    tabla<-NULL
    
    tabla$long<- c(input$num2)
    tabla$lat<- c(input$num1)
    tabla$resp<-c(input$num3)
    tabla$loc<-c(input$num4)
    tabla$pcia<-c(input$num5)
    tabla$año<-c(input$num6)
    tabla<-as.data.frame(tabla)
    tabla1<-read.csv("data/tabla1.csv")
    tabla1<-rbind(tabla1,tabla)
    tabla1<-as.data.frame(tabla1)
    coordinates(tabla1) <- ~lat+long
    proj4string(tabla1) <- CRS("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")
    m <- plotGoogleMaps(tabla1,zcol="año", filename = 'myMap1.html',legend=F,control=F,openMap = F)
    tags$iframe(
      srcdoc = paste(gsub("http://maps.google.com/", "https://maps.google.com/", readLines('myMap1.html'), fixed=TRUE),collapse = '\n'),
      width = "100%",
      height = "500px"
      
    )
  })
})

Loading required package: bitops

package that contains the function `train()` in your app.
